description: Engrave an era trophy — one of §7's eight primorials (CONCEPT.md §4.7.1, D-212), by the trophy's holder. The first engraving is free (gas only); every later one costs the registrar's trophy rename fee in GRAM. The number's own name is primes_name_number.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.
